summary: Wired sveltekit-frontend/scripts/phase79-agentic-repair.mts to construct and persist a canonical WorkflowActionEventV1 (atlas.workflow-action.v1) for every authorized repair attempt's terminal outcome, closing the explicit follow-up recorded by workflow-action-schema-owner-01. Construction logic is a new pure module (no side effects); persistence reuses the existing writeCanonicalWorkflowActionAtomically() writer. No new persistence path, no change to Phase 79's mutation/apply/rollback logic.

perFileDisposition.note: Pure builder, no top-level side effects, no DB connection required. Exports buildPhase79CanonicalWorkflowActionEvent().

Added emitCanonicalWorkflowActionEvent() (calls the pure builder then writeCanonicalWorkflowActionAtomically()), called from processOneSuggestion() after ledgerResult is computed. Updated header docstring and sessionReceipt.persistencePolicy to describe the new emission honestly. No change to --apply/--dry-run gating, risk-level gating, or file-mutation/rollback logic.

writeCanonicalWorkflowActionAtomically() and CanonicalActionRequestV1 already existed (built/tested earlier this session for workflow-action-schema-owner-01's collision-detection work) and were reused as-is -- no new persistence path invented.
5 tests covering completed-with-receipt, succeeded-without-persisted-ledger (honest skip), failed-with-real-errorCode, failed-with-null-failureReason fallback, and idempotency-key distinctness.

identityMappingDecisions.workflowId: phase79-repair:${suggestion.id} -- each repair attempt is its own workflow instance
identityMappingDecisions.sequence: 0 -- exactly one action per workflow instance
identityMappingDecisions.actionId: fresh randomUUID() -- required by prepareCanonicalActionWriteV1's UUID enforcement (agent_run_actions.action_id is a uuid column)
identityMappingDecisions.runId: fresh randomUUID() -- same UUID constraint (agent_runs.run_id); distinct from Phase 79's own human-readable sessionId, preserved in metadata.sessionId instead
identityMappingDecisions.dagNodeId: constant 'phase79.repair-attempt' -- names the one operation-class Phase 79 always executes; not a real DAG node
identityMappingDecisions.lane: 'tool' -- best fit among WORKFLOW_ACTION_LANES, matches recordAnalysisPassResult()'s own passType: 'tool_execution'
identityMappingDecisions.kind: 'completed' or 'failed', mapped directly from Phase 79's existing status field
identityMappingDecisions.tenantId: documented nil-UUID sentinel 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 -- no real multi-tenant concept exists for Phase 79; no prior production caller in this repo had established a system-tenant convention (only test fixtures use a non-UUID placeholder, which would fail against the real Postgres uuid column)

receiptIdAndErrorCodeHandling.completedRequiresReceiptId: Only constructed when analysis_pass_results actually persisted (ledgerResult.persisted === true); receiptId = String(rowId). If not persisted, the builder returns { skipped: true, reason: 'NO_RECEIPT_ID_AVAILABLE_LEDGER_NOT_PERSISTED' } rather than fabricating a receiptId. This is a disclosed real gap: some successful repairs will not get a canonical event until REPAIR-MUTATION-OWNER-BINDING-01 supplies a real governed-mutation receipt.
receiptIdAndErrorCodeHandling.failedRequiresErrorCode: Derived from the real thrown-error message's leading colon-delimited token (e.g. 'VERIFICATION_NOT_IMPROVED:before=3/1:after=3/1' -> 'VERIFICATION_NOT_IMPROVED'). Falls back to 'UNKNOWN_FAILURE' only when failureReason is null.

testResults.tsgo --noEmit (repo-wide): 0 errors attributable to either touched file; 74 pre-existing errors in unrelated files (nodejs-whisper missing types, QdrantClient.search typing mismatches, GoRetrievalSearchHit.source typo) confirmed unchanged by this work

notAttempted: No live end-to-end run of phase79-agentic-repair.mts --apply against a real Postgres instance with real pending error_suggestions rows and a running Ornith/llama-server -- that is AGENTIC-REPAIR-CANARY-01's scope, explicitly out of scope here. The actual writeCanonicalWorkflowActionAtomically() DB write was therefore never executed live in this change; only its inputs (the constructed WorkflowActionEventV1) were proven schema-valid.
No consumer (Kanban projection, A2A listener, LangGraph checkpoint/resume) reads these events back yet.
openQuestionsCarriedForward: Whether Phase 78, Kanban, or A2A should adopt the same PHASE79_SYSTEM_TENANT_ID nil-UUID convention, or a real shared system-tenant identity should be minted once multiple callers exist.

Whether REPAIR-MUTATION-OWNER-BINDING-01 should eventually supply a real governed-mutation receipt Phase 79 could use as receiptId for successful repairs whose analysis_pass_results write did not persist, closing the disclosed gap above.
